note: Synthetic expert resolution knowledge for WO-2026-1107-003

messages.author: Mikko Virtanen
messages.text: Saw the thread on TRN-117 port 1/1/3. Do NOT swap the SFP again or reboot the node! On TX-2000 running firmware 4.1, optical hot-swap leaves the internal forwarding ASIC in a paused state even when alarms are clear.

messages.author: Mikko Virtanen
messages.text: Workaround: Disable port 1/1/3 ('interface 1/1/3 shutdown'), wait 30 seconds, then re-enable it ('no shutdown'). Forwarding ASIC reinitializes and traffic will flow immediately.

messages.author: Jari Järvinen
messages.text: Flapped 1/1/3 as advised. Traffic counters jumped to 4.2 Gbps right away, services SVC-MBH-0117 and SVC-MBH-0125 restored. No hardware reboot needed.
